artworks.title: River Landscape with High Cliffs
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with architectural features integrated into cliffs. There is a detailed tree on the left, a waterway winding through a valley, and a church with two spires atop a cliff on the right. The drawing uses fine hatching and cross-hatching techniques to create texture and shading. The scene has a monochromatic color palette, rich in contrasts and detailed textures.

artworks.title: River Landscape with a Footbridge
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 8.7 x 17.2 cm (3 7/16 x 6 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a ground-level view of a wooden bridge stretching towards a village by a river. The bridge is made of planks and posts, leading towards clusters of rooftops and a round building with a turret. In the background, rolling hills are visible. The horizon line is at the upper third with faint outlines of distant hills and trees. On the right, there is a detailed tree with cross-hatching and linear strokes for texture. The style is pen-and-ink with fine and detailed brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white. The scene is framed by two tall trees and features details like the carved year "1546" on a stone.

artworks.title: Saint Florian
artworks.artist: Johann Beheim after Franz Anton Maulbertsch
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper, mounted on album sheet
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a classical male figure standing prominently, with a dynamic pose. He is leaning slightly forward, with his torso twisted, and an arm stretched outward holding a sword. His facial features are partially visible and he appears to have long, flowing hair. The attire is elaborate, reminiscent of Roman or Greek armor, detailed with folds and sections that suggest movement. Beside him, a cherub or small angelic figure is pouring water from a vessel. In the background, there are draped fabrics and architectural elements. The image is executed in dark and light contrasts and intricate cross-hatching, typical of classical engravings.

artworks.title: Kalaat el Hosn (Castle of the Knights, Syria)
artworks.description: The image captures a view of an ancient stone castle or fortress from a low vantage point. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the image, showing the roof of the castle walls meeting the night sky. The silhouette of stone blocks and eroded walls is visible along the horizon. The scene exudes an eerie atmosphere with shadows cast by the rugged terrain and stonework, potentially under moonlight. The texture of the image gives it an aged appearance, resembling photographic grain. The color palette is predominantly sepia tones, deep grays, and browns, enhancing the historical and moody feel. The walls and path closest to the viewer display a rough, stone texture that fades into darkness as the scene extends into the distance.

artworks.title: Portrait of Woman and Child
artworks.dimensions: image: 19 x 12.5 cm (7 1/2 x 4 15/16 in.), irregular
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. and Joyce Menschel Fund and The Sarah and William L Walton Fund
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals from the waist up, standing close together. One person is turned slightly towards the right, showing their face in profile. Their hair is styled close to the head. They wear a garment with a structured collar, long sleeves, and a repeated pattern of vertical lines. The other person is mainly in profile, facing left with their face obscured by shadow. They wear an outfit with subtle stripes. The background has a textured surface with faint leafy shapes. The image has a photographic negative effect.

artworks.title: Marie LaPorte
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl sitting on a wooden chair with a cross-back design. She is facing slightly to the right and looking towards the camera. Her eyes are closed, and she has long braided hair. She is wearing a checkered dress with puffed sleeves and a necklace with a pendant around her neck. The background is blurred with natural elements.

artworks.title: Marie LaPorte
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image depicts a young girl sitting in a profile position. She has long, straight hair styled in two braids, wearing a check-patterned dress with flared sleeves. She is holding a small bunch of flowers while sitting in front of blurred natural foliage.

artworks.title: Venus and the Graces Crowning Thémire
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with brown wash over traces of graphite, on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical mythological scene. The scene depicts a group of female figures in an ethereal setting surrounded by clouds and nature elements. They are depicted with flowing garments and engaging in a graceful ritual or gathering. Cherubic figures are interspersed among them. The setting is under a large tree with expansive branches. The drawing captures the elegance and harmony of the figures and their environment with delicate lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.medium: red chalk over traces of black chalk on three joined pieces of laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed red chalk drawing depicting several figures seated against a backdrop of architectural elements. At the center, a woman holds a child on her lap, while another woman leans towards them. A young naked child stands beside the second woman. An elderly bearded man extends his arm towards the child. On the right, two men look towards the central figures while a woman seated at the bottom right holds a bundle of cloth. The figures are dressed in draped garments. The background shows a textured wall, possibly indicating a building or interior space, with a faint window opening or niche visible.

artworks.title: Painters on Their Travels (Die Maler auf der Reise)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a mountainous landscape with four individuals engaged in conversation. One person is seated under an umbrella, sketching or writing, while the others are standing around talking. The figures are dressed in period attire, carrying walking sticks, backpacks, and hats. The background shows mountains, trees, and a small structure resembling a chapel or house on the right. The level of detail in the attire and shading in the landscape showcases high craftsmanship and adds to the narrative of an intellectual or artistic discourse in nature.

artworks.title: Head of a Bearded Man, Looking Right
artworks.description: The image is a graphite drawing of a man's head and shoulders in profile. The man is facing right, showing his facial features, including a prominent nose and detailed profile. He has a long beard that reaches his chest, and his hair is flowing backward. The man is not wearing any visible clothing or accessories, and no objects are held in his hands. The drawing is set against a plain, textured background of light blue paper.

artworks.title: Bearded Man Looking Up / Cloaked Figure with Raised Arms
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man's head and shoulders. The man faces right with a slightly downward tilted head. He has a long beard, wavy hair, a prominent nose, and a furrowed expression. He appears to be wearing a robe or garment with a broad collar. The background is a textured light blue surface. There are no visible items of jewelry or other objects in the image.

artworks.title: Wedding Group
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund

artworks.title: Winter Fronds of the Prickly Fern
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr. and Mariana Cook

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl seated in profile, visible from head to foot. She is sitting on a chair or bench, facing left. Her profile reveals delicate facial features and light complexion. Her hair is styled back, likely tied with a ribbon. She wears a blue dress with ruffles, pink ribbon details, and a pink shawl. She has dark shoes and light stockings. Surrounding her are green bushes and foliage, with a painted backdrop of a cloudy sky over water in the distance. The image is framed in gold.

artworks.title: The Bells
artworks.medium: drypoint and colored pencil on laid paper [touched proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The individual is positioned to the side, facing slightly towards the left. Their facial features are delicate and subtle, with a calm expression. The hair is mostly covered by an elaborate headdress, which has a jester-like shape with two peaks, each adorned with a round ornament. The clothing is long and flowing, with intricate details that suggest a textured fabric, extending to the ground. In the background, there is a minimalistic, light-toned setting with faint lines and shadows, creating an airy, open space that emphasizes the figure. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects held by the person.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Les Salles d'Estampes"
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and stipple in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift from the Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description:
This is a drawing depicting an entrance to an exhibition or gallery space. The scene is framed by an architectural archway, with signage above the entrance reading "Les Salles D'Estampes" meaning "The Print Rooms." Below, there are words "En Province" and a reference to a publication "Publiées dans le Journal des Arts 1884–85" visible. 

The composition is in a monochromatic, sepia tone. Two figures stand in the foreground under the archway. Inside the building, a larger space with high ceilings and arches is visible through a doorway, suggesting classical architecture. Various details such as framed artworks and architectural elements like columns are depicted, contributing to a cultured setting.

artworks.title: The Coat of Arms of Wigeleus von Fröschel, Bishop of Passau
artworks.medium: woodcut with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic coat of arms with two angels and a large bishop's mitre. The coat of arms is quartered, featuring lions in red sections and frog-like creatures in black sections, with a smaller inescutcheon in the center showing a lion. Two angels support the coat of arms and hold a bishop's mitre above it. The colors include reds, greens, black, and gold. The composition is framed with intricate black linework.

artworks.title: The Backgammon Players
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene inside an interior room. The image shows a group of people playing a game involving a board with pieces on it. The individuals are wearing period clothing. The composition has light and dark areas, creating a sense of depth and focus on the central action on the table. The room's interior includes draped curtains. The style is reminiscent of Rembrandt, with expressive figures engaged in the game.

artworks.title: The Large Tree
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 31.9 x 24.5 cm (12 9/16 x 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a large tree in the center against a light background. The tree is captured in a silhouette, emphasizing its height and branches. The base of the tree shows a thin, dark horizon with hints of a fence and plants. In the background, there is a shadowy outline of a forest or dense trees. An animal, likely a cow, is standing near the base of the tree, partially hidden in shadows. The artwork shows detailed brushstrokes to depict the texture of the tree's leaves and branches. The color scheme is warm and monochromatic with shades of sepia and brown.

artworks.title: Farmhouse
artworks.description: The image shows a thatched-roof building surrounded by trees, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The composition is captured beneath intricate tree branches, with bold and dense brushstrokes emphasizing texture and contrast. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on tones of black and cream to highlight details against a pale background.

artworks.title: Portrait of Madame de Nittis ("Attenzione")
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and lavis on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an artistic etching of a woman, from head to slightly below the knees. She is seated in a relaxed pose, with her upper body slightly turned to her left side and her left arm resting over the back of a chair. The woman has detailed facial features, neat updo hair, and wears a long dress with elaborate details and layers. The background is plain without any visible objects or accessories.

artworks.title: Entrance to the Forest
artworks.description: This image depicts a dense and intricate wooded landscape from a ground-level perspective. The artwork shows a maze of gnarled tree trunks on the left side that overlap and entwine. As the eye moves from left to right, a path is revealed meandering through the trees towards a clearing in the distance. The horizon is subtly defined with the sky meeting a far-off landscape, with the silhouettes of treetops against it. The etching technique is evident in the finely articulated lines and cross-hatching that create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on contrasts between dark and light to create drama and emphasis, and shadows and highlights add depth and detail to the scene.

artworks.title: A Hermit Saint
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of an elderly man with long hair and a lengthy beard, seated at a table. His face is marked with deep lines, and he is wearing a loose garment. In front of him, there is an open book with text on the pages, and he is holding a string of prayer beads in his left hand. A crucifix, a small container, and some fruit are on the table. The background features detailed foliage.
